summary: BlackRock TCP Capital Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the completed sale of 95% of its interests in a continuation vehicle (BlackRock DLF-C 2026, LLC) to funds managed by Pantheon Ventures (US) LP, while retaining 5%. The transaction closed August 4, 2026, generating ~$152 million gross proceeds and reducing net leverage from 1.38x to ~0.4x. The vehicle holds ~$523 million of loans across 78 portfolio companies, with ~two-thirds of each position transferred (48% of pre-transaction debt portfolio). The board believes the sale realizes a substantial premium to share price and enhances strategic flexibility. Watch for follow-on strategic alternatives or additional transactions.
